qualification_this_checkpoint.input_domain: Defined computable probabilities strictly between zero and one, with arbitrary seed integers and binary scales. The existing Real probability/tail admission contract is unchanged. General native expression-domain and extreme precision/resource bounds remain open.
qualification_this_checkpoint.migration: Seeds are retained evaluation hints rather than certified values. Imported valid graph bytes remain unchanged. The native constructor now canonicalizes exact half probability to zero and recognized rational-CDF inverses to their exact values. Approximation integers may change within their documented one-ulp contract; this is a correctness repair, not a performance-only or identical-serialization claim for those native exact constructions.
qualification_this_checkpoint.modeling_method: Cargo builds the public modeling library in minimal and curve,sdf,metaballs,svg-io configurations; rustc compiles the unchanged integration sources against those exact libraries. Unrelated competitive C++ dev dependencies and the full root CI matrix are not covered.
qualification_this_checkpoint.next: Continue native domain obligations and ordinary strict-mode completion, then the complete external user-path and release validation.
qualification_this_checkpoint.proof_argument: For a trial at precision p-2, strict CDF bounds at trial +/- 2 units enclose the root within half a result ulp. Rounding the trial adds at most half an ulp. Comparisons require a gap greater than the sum of the two approximation errors. Monotonicity supplies search direction; an exact midpoint comparison can decline while the neighboring bracket certifies. A bracket of width at most one result ulp permits midpoint rounding with total error at most one ulp. Newton only proposes points inside a previously certified bracket. The bounded scalar normalizer may suggest a rational inverse from a retained erf argument; structural equality with a complete reconstructed native CDF proves that identity independently of the seed. This is an implementation argument conditional on the native CDF approximation contract, not a new formal verification result.
remaining_limitations: General non-leaf domain/range admission remains open, including the earlier false zero fact on an undefined zero product.
The native quantile constructor still requires a defined probability in its mathematical domain; this patch does not add a general typed domain validator.
Finite tests and independent numerical oracles do not establish complete producer verification or all expression/precision/resource behavior.
Full geometry/DRC runtime gates, actual foreign-language consumers, clean shipped-distribution validation and the full properties plan remain open.
Historical missing artifacts were not reaudited or recovered. Present build artifacts moved to Disk B with verified compatibility aliases; small helper scripts still have temporary paths.
qualification_this_checkpoint.resource_limitations: Trial magnitudes only choose guard precision; they never prove a result. General import, extreme requested precisions, coefficients, expression growth and total work remain externally contained. Cancellation uses the existing raw approximation signal interface; typed cancellation and exhaustion for all native evaluation are not established by these tests.
